author: Harvey Davis
text: Not clear why you uninstalled and reinstalled the app, I think you burned a sensor, but call Abbott before you remove it.

author: Jennifer Mini
text: The reason why I had to uninstall and reinstall the app was because my phone did an update and the app kept saying lost signal or lost alarm anyways Abbott is sending me a new one because they was an alarm code that kept coming up and they said technically it should have reconnected with my phone. They said that if I just updated the app it would have reconnected to the same sensor but there was a code that kept coming up they had me look at the log but I'm thankful they're sending me a free replacement
